name: Amazon Computers
description: A co-purchase graph with about 13k nodes, evaluated with the Shchur random-split protocol. Amazon Photo is a related co-purchase graph. Distinct from the Amazon review corpora already recorded; no data is vendored here.
citation: Amazon Computers; Shchur et al. (2019), Pitfalls of Graph Neural Network Evaluation, International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2019).
